dimensions.note: Handles no credentials and reads no auth tokens. Discovered config objects are passed through redact() with redactSecrets defaulting true, replacing secret-looking keys with [redacted]. Redaction is key-based and documented as best-effort.
discover() logs structured entry ('Discovering Kilo Code config from {dir}') and completion with counts. No string interpolation and no secret values logged.

Discovery is best-effort: safeStat/exists swallow stat errors, readLimited closes the handle in finally, and unreadable config is recorded as a warning rather than thrown. realPathOrResolve falls back to a resolved path when realPath fails.

kilo_project_test.ts covers stripJsonComments (line/block comments, // inside strings, escaped quotes) and redact (recursive secret keys, arrays, primitives, case-insensitivity). Filesystem-walking discovery is not unit-tested.
Read-only discovery; reruns are idempotent and write the same three outputs. No external mutations and nothing to clean up.
No external HTTP or network calls; local filesystem inspection only.
readLimited closes the Deno file handle in a finally block; walkers use Deno.readDir iteration which self-closes. No temp files or connections.
README uses generic paths (.kilo, .swamp) and no real hostnames, IPs, or account identifiers. Tests use synthetic config objects.
All schemas are plain z.object(...) with no .passthrough(); CEL validation works.
inventory and health resources plus the summary file set lifetime 30d and garbageCollection 10, appropriate for an occasional inventory snapshot.
Not a CRUD lifecycle model — it is a read-only inventory/discovery model.
No mutating methods, so no pre-flight gate is required.
discover()/summarise() write inventory-current, health-current, and summary-current — unique per spec and identical shape for both methods.
Stateless discovery; reads no stored resources and uses no dataRepository access.
Bumped to 2026.10.14.1 with a no-op upgrades entry (source moved to swamp-extensions; no schema changes) so existing instances advance their typeVersion from the 2026.09.29.2 published baseline.

mechanical.schema-write-conformance: pass — discover() builds the inventory/health objects in one place and writes them with the summary file; the schemas match the assembled objects. best-effort discovery populates all declared fields with empty collections where nothing was found.
mechanical.truncation-honesty: pass — file reads are capped by maxFileBytes and oversized/truncated files are surfaced through health warnings rather than silently dropped.
mechanical.instance-name-consistency: pass — each spec has exactly one writer instance name (inventory-current, health-current) plus the summary file summary-current.
mechanical.schema-field-coverage: pass — every declared field has a producing code path; optional frontmatter is only present when parsed.
